concerns.text: FR-011 (System MUST compute the Packing Coefficient (PC) as defined in FR-003) is not referenced in any phase of the implementation plan; no script or phase lists this requirement.

SC-001 (final dataset must contain ≥ 500 complete records) is not explicitly mapped to any phase or script in the plan; the plan mentions dataset acquisition but does not tie it to this success criterion.
SC-005 (entire pipeline must complete ≤ 6 h on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner) is not addressed by any phase or performance goal in the plan; no task or metric verifies this runtime constraint.
